author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Wild tangents, baffling interruptions, and a healthy dose of chaos grip Bethesda Game Studios when Sheogorath, the great Prince of Madness pays an unexpected visit to the office.

Sheogorath can't recall if he's read these lines before, and he's not happy about it. The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered comes to Nintendo Switch 2 on August 11, bringing Bethesda Game Studios’ classic open-world RPG to a new platform with stunning new visuals, refined gameplay and the complete story experience.
